') center /cover no-repeat;z-index:0}
/* The original artwork's raster buttons are covered by a continuous right-hand wall. */
#mainMenu .mmWall{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:43%;z-index:1;
 background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(20,20,37,0) 0%,rgba(20,20,37,.92) 11%,#191729 32%,#1a192c 100%)}
#mainMenu .mmLogo{position:absolute;z-index:2;top:2.8%;right:7.1%;width:31%;height:29%;object-fit:contain;pointer-events:none;
 filter:drop-shadow(2px 4px 0 #060710)}
#mainMenu .mmButtons{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:65.1%;width:31.0%;top:35.2%;bottom:7.6%;
 display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:clamp(5px,1vh,12px)}
#mainMenu .mmButton{appearance:none;position:relative;min-height:0;min-width:0;flex:1 1 0;
 display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:clamp(8px,1.2vw,18px);
 border:clamp(2px,.26vw,4px) solid #1f8eb4;border-radius:9px;
 background:linear-gradient(180deg,#15374f 0%,#10293d 54%,#0d2131 55%,#0a1827 100%);
 box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #0a1220,inset 0 2px 0 #79d8f0,inset 0 -4px 0 #0d4b60,0 0 0 2px #07111a,0 5px 0 #040910;
 color:#f2f7fa;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #07101a;
 font-family:inherit;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.05em;font-size:clamp(11px,2.35vh,23px);line-height:1.02;
 cursor:pointer;transition:filter .08s,transform .08s;padding:2px 10px;text-align:center}
#mainMenu .mmButton::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:4px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid rgba(133,224,255,.22);pointer-events:none}
#mainMenu .mmButton span.mmBtnIcon{flex:0 0 auto;font-family:'PixelFont',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:1.05em;min-width:1.35em;text-align:center;color:#f0c861;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #3c2504}
#mainMenu .mmButton span.mmBtnText{white-space:nowrap}
#mainMenu .mmButton:where(:hover,:focus-visible){filter:brightness(1.12);outline:2px solid #d8fbff;outline-offset:2px}
#mainMenu .mmButton:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #0a1220,inset 0 1px 0 #79d8f0,inset 0 -2px 0 #0d4b60,0 0 0 2px #07111a,0 2px 0 #040910}
#mainMenu .mmButton.mmPrimary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffd650 0%,#f5c134 46%,#e6a10d 47%,#b96b03 100%);color:#1a1308;
 text-shadow:1px 1px 0 #fff0b0;border-color:#f0c766;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #5a3303,inset 0 2px 0 #fff0af,inset 0 -4px 0 #8f5507,0 0 0 2px #1e1206,0 5px 0 #090502}
#mainMenu .mmButton.mmPrimary::before{border-color:rgba(255,249,206,.38)}
#mainMenu .mmButton.mmPrimary span.mmBtnIcon{color:#181007;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 #fff0b0}
#mainMenu .mmTools{position:absolute;top:1.8%;right:1.8%;z-index:4;display:flex;gap:clamp(6px,.75vw,12px)}
#mainMenu .mmTool{appearance:none;display:grid;place-items:center;width:clamp(31px,5.2vw,74px);height:clamp(31px,7.5vh,70px);
 background:linear-gradient(180deg,#163953 0%,#0f2b42 54%,#0b1e2e 55%,#081623 100%);
 border:3px solid #2f9fc3;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #0a1220,inset 0 2px 0 #82def5,inset 0 -4px 0 #0d4b60,0 0 0 2px #07111a,0 4px 0 #040910;
 font-family:inherit;font-size:clamp(18px,2.4vw,30px);color:#f8f5eb;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
#mainMenu .mmTool:where(:hover,:focus-visible){filter:brightness(1.12);outline:2px solid #d8fbff;outline-offset:2px}
#mainMenu .mmTool:active{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #0a1220,inset 0 1px 0 #82def5,inset 0 -2px 0 #0d4b60,0 0 0 2px #07111a,0 2px 0 #040910}
#mainMenu .mmPanel{position:absolute;z-index:10;right:3%;top:32%;width:min(42%,580px);max-height:62%;overflow:auto;
 padding:clamp(10px,1.4vw,22px);background:#081724f5;border:4px solid #1f8eb4;border-radius:12px;
 box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #0a1220,inset 0 0 0 5px #16334e,0 0 0 2px #07111a,0 12px 30px #000a;
 font-size:clamp(10px,1.7vh,17px)}
#mainMenu .mmPanel h2{margin:0 0 1em;text-align:center;font-size:1.5em;color:#ffd266;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #3b2408}
#mainMenu .mmPanel p{font-family:inherit;line-height:1.5;color:#e0edf5}
#mainMenu .mmPanel .mmButton{height:clamp(36px,6vh,60px);margin-top:1em;flex:none;width:100%;font-size:1em}
#mainMenu .mmCheck{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:clamp(8px,1vw,14px);border:2px solid #2e6e88;border-radius:8px;margin:9px 0;background:#102a3d}
#mainMenu .mmCheck input{width:20px;height:20px;accent-color:#ffe082}
#mainMenu .mmRecordsTable{font-size:.93em;width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
#mainMenu .mmRecordsTable td{padding:8px 5px;border-bottom:1px solid #49607b}
#mainMenu .mmRotateHint{display:none}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:540px){
 #mainMenu .mmButtons{top:33.5%;bottom:3.2%;gap:4px}
 #mainMenu .mmLogo{top:1.5%;height:28%}
 #mainMenu .mmButton{font-size:clamp(10px,2.75vh,16px);border-width:2px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #0a1220,inset 0 1px 0 #79d8f0,inset 0 -3px 0 #0d4b60,0 0 0 2px #07111a,0 2px 0 #040910}
 #mainMenu .mmButton::before{inset:3px;border-radius:5px}
 #mainMenu .mmPanel{top:27%;max-height:70%;font-size:clamp(9px,2.5vh,13px);border-width:2px}
 #mainMenu .mmTool{border-width:2px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #0a1220,inset 0 1px 0 #82def5,inset 0 -3px 0 #0d4b60,0 0 0 2px #07111a,0 2px 0 #040910}
}
@media (orientation:portrait) and (max-width:650px){
 #mainMenu .mmRotateHint{display:flex;position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:20;justify-content:center;align-items:center;
 padding:24px;text-align:center;background:#081222ef;color:#fff;font-size:clamp(15px,3vw,22px);line-height:1.7}
}

/* v0.5.6bp — exact approved menu button artwork. Each button is still a
   real accessible HTML button; pixels are native reference sprites. */
#mainMenu #mmButtons>.mmButton {
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;
  border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;outline:none;
  background-color:transparent!important;
  background-repeat:no-repeat!important;
  background-position:center center!important;
  background-size:100% 100%!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
  text-shadow:none!important;
  width:100%;min-height:0;min-width:0;flex:1 1 0;
  padding:0!important;
  image-rendering:auto;
  font-size:clamp(10px,2.65vh,22px);
  transition:filter 90ms ease,transform 90ms ease;
}
#mainMenu #mmButtons>.mmButton::before {display:none!important;content:none!important}
#mainMenu #mmButtons>.mmButton span {opacity:0!important;pointer-events:none!important}
#mainMenu #mmButtons>.mmButton:is(:hover,:focus-visible) {
  filter:brightness(1.09);outline:2px solid #f4dfaa;outline-offset:2px;
}
#mainMenu #mmButtons>.mmButton:active{transform:translateY(2px);filter:brightness(.93)}
@media(hover:none) {#mainMenu #mmButtons>.mmButton:hover{filter:none}}
